properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8 v9 v10

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU eyakubibwa-edda,
-Era eyafa ku lwaffe;
Laba-amaanyi n'ekitiibwa
Leero bwe bifaananye.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Mulabe Yesu bw'ajja ng'ayambadde-
Ekitiibwa kye;
Ye ng'amaze okusinga
Abalabe be bonna.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Eyalaba-ennaku-ennyingi,
Edda eyakaaba-ennyo;
Mulabe n'essanyu lingi
Bw'amasamasa leero.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Kabaka wa bakabaka,
Alifuga-ensi zonna;
Abantu bonna-ab'oku nsi
Balimuvuunamira.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Kale bulijjo enjiri,
Bonna tubabuulire;
Ayanguwe-ajje n'ebire,
Alye-obwakabaka bwe.
